Method of Attack: Installed and started a SOCKS proxy on infected devices to await commands from a remote botnet command and control (C&C) server
Potential to relay malicious traffic or carry out DDoS attacks
Attack Vector: Malicious Android apps posing as player skin apps for Minecraft Pocket Edition
Indicators of Compromise: Infected apps removed from Google Play Store
Installation count ranging from 600,000 to 2.6 million
